title: Special provisions applying along district boundaries
previewText: Whenever a Manufacturing District adjoins a Residence District, at any point at the district boundary or within the Residence District, the maximum permitted decibel levels in all octave bands shall be reduced by six decibels from the maximum levels set forth in the table in Section 42-413 (Maximum permitted decibel levels).
